Zaril's chat: the proposed changes side by side

Each pair shows a chat block as the game plays it now and with the change, both captured in the emulator from the current English build (main 4a53dc4). The changed version was played with the table edit laid into MCARD in RAM; no disc was built. Rows line up by speaker, and every page of a reply has its own shot with the text below it. Whatever differs from the left column is marked in gold.

Blocks 6, 9 and 10 are approved and left off this page, and blocks 7 and 12 stay as they are. Only block 13 is open, and the choice there also decides block 8.
